**P-LUMA Nova 1.4.5** for Minecraft 26.2 · 26.1–26.1.2 · 1.21.11 · 1.21.10 · 1.21.8 · 1.21.7 · 1.21.6

Download the jar for **your exact Minecraft version** from the assets below. You also need
[Fabric Loader](https://fabricmc.net/use/) 0.19.3+ and [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).
Lithium, FerriteCore and ImmediatelyFast are already inside. Replace your old P-LUMA jar; settings are kept.

## What's new

**Interface**
- Flatter, cleaner look: tight corners on buttons, cards, inputs and switches instead of rounded pills
- HUD element corners are now sharp, soft or round (soft by default); existing layouts switch to soft once

**Fixes**
- "Only tags you are looking at" follows the camera (free look, third person) and adapts to your FOV
- Command macros no longer fire when the key that closes a menu is bound to them
- Settings are saved safely; a broken file is kept as `.corrupt` instead of being overwritten
- Unlimited chat history is capped at 50,000 lines to keep memory in check
